grammar_title: 过去将来时(would do / was going to do):从过去看的将来 + 过去的打算
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第三册 Unit 5 Using language:过去将来时。主句为过去视角(said/knew/promised…或 was/were going to + but…),故过去将来形式唯一成立;干扰项 will(视角错)/一般过去(尚未发生)排除。句子地道、答案唯一。

points.point: would do(从过去某点看的将来 / 转述的将来)
points.overview: 主句是过去时(said/knew/promised/believed…)、所说的事在当时还没发生(常带 the next day/one day/soon/never…again 等将来标志)时,从句用 would + 动词原形;此时 will 视角错、一般过去尚未发生都不对。

points.point: was / were going to do(过去的打算、计划，常未实现)
points.overview: 表示过去某时打算/准备做某事(常用 but… 引出没做成),用 was/were going to + 动词原形;现在的 am/is/are going to 视角错、will 视角错、一般过去(表示已做了)与 but 矛盾,都不对。

points.point: 过去将来在转述句中 · 与一般过去/将来的区分
points.overview: 转述过去的话语/想法时,原来的 will→would、be going to→was/were going to;判断靠过去主句与将来标志:从过去看仍未发生用过去将来,已发生用一般过去,从现在看才用 will。

questions.stem: Before the climb, Mallory promised his wife that he ____ home safely.
questions.explanation: 主句 promised 是过去时,'平安回家'当时还没发生 → 过去将来 would come;will 视角错,一般过去尚未发生。

questions.stem: The captain announced that the ship ____ port at dawn the next day.
questions.explanation: announced 过去 + the next day 将来标志 → would leave。

questions.stem: None of the sailors knew that those days ____ their last together.
questions.explanation: knew 过去、当时并不知道结局 → 从过去看的将来 would be。

questions.stem: The old sailor said that he ____ to the sea again one day.
questions.explanation: said 过去 + again one day 将来 → would return。

questions.stem: Arnette believed that the mountain ____ his life into focus.
questions.explanation: believed 过去,所信之事指向将来 → would bring。

questions.stem: The psychologist predicted that risk-takers ____ always look for new thrills.
questions.explanation: predicted 过去 + always(指向将来) → would look。

questions.stem: We were excited because we thought the voyage ____ our lives.
questions.explanation: thought 过去、改变尚未发生 → would change。

questions.stem: The doctor explained that the injury ____ within a few weeks.
questions.explanation: explained 过去 + within a few weeks 将来 → would heal。

questions.stem: As a boy, Verne dreamed that he ____ one day sail around the world.
questions.explanation: dreamed 过去 + one day 将来 → would sail。

questions.stem: The forecast warned that the temperature ____ below minus sixty.
questions.explanation: warned 过去、所预警之事尚未发生 → would drop。

questions.stem: Conseil was sure that Captain Nemo ____ never let them leave the submarine.
questions.explanation: was sure 过去 + never(指向将来) → would let。

questions.stem: Aronnax realised that words ____ never be enough to describe such wonders.
questions.explanation: realised 过去,从过去看的判断 → would be。

questions.stem: The team hoped that the good weather ____ until they reached the top.
questions.explanation: hoped 过去、天气能否维持指向将来 → would hold。

questions.stem: Hours earlier, no one imagined that the calm sea ____ soon turn deadly.
questions.explanation: imagined 过去 + soon 将来 → would turn。

questions.stem: The instructor told the divers that the seals ____ them among the seaweed.
questions.explanation: told 过去、跟随尚未发生 → would follow。

questions.stem: Mallory wrote that the adventure ____ him nothing but sheer joy.
questions.explanation: wrote 过去,所写的将来感受 → would give。

questions.stem: The captain felt certain that they ____ on the island for many months.
questions.explanation: felt certain 过去 + for many months(指向将来) → would remain。

questions.stem: Before the expedition, the doctor said low air pressure ____ some climbers sick.
questions.explanation: said 过去、所说之事指向旅途中的将来 → would make。

questions.stem: The young climber was sure this experience ____ him far stronger.
questions.explanation: was sure 过去,从过去看的将来 → would make。

questions.stem: We all believed that help ____ before nightfall.
questions.explanation: believed 过去 + before nightfall(尚未发生) → would arrive。

questions.stem: I ____ some water, but the storm broke all our barrels.
questions.explanation: 过去的打算且未实现(but…) → was going to collect;现在 am going to/will 视角错,collected 表示已收集到与 but 矛盾。

questions.stem: We ____ the tent, but the wind was far too strong.
questions.explanation: 过去打算 + but 未做成 → were going to put up。

questions.stem: The sailors ____ a fire, but they could not find any dry logs.
questions.explanation: 过去打算未实现 → were going to build。

questions.stem: I ____ for food, but I hurt my arm on the rocks.
questions.explanation: 过去打算 + but 受伤未做 → was going to hunt。

questions.stem: Arnette ____ several other peaks, but bad weather stopped him.
questions.explanation: 过去的计划被天气打断 → was going to climb。

questions.stem: We ____ home that week, but the captain changed the plan.
questions.explanation: 过去打算 + but 计划改变 → were going to sail。

questions.stem: Mallory ____ at the camp, but the clear sky tempted him higher.
questions.explanation: 过去打算未实现 → was going to rest。

questions.stem: The divers ____ the shipwreck, but the water was too rough.
questions.explanation: 过去计划被海况打断 → were going to explore。

questions.stem: I ____ a photo of the summit, but my hands were frozen.
questions.explanation: 过去打算 + but 未拍成 → was going to take。

questions.stem: They ____ port at dawn, but a thick fog held them back.
questions.explanation: 过去打算被大雾阻拦 → were going to leave。

questions.stem: She ____ the expedition, but her injury kept her at home.
questions.explanation: 过去打算未实现 → was going to join。

questions.stem: We ____ the death zone before noon, but the snow slowed us down.
questions.explanation: 过去计划被大雪打乱 → were going to cross。

questions.stem: The captain ____ to his family, but there was no time before the voyage.
questions.explanation: 过去打算 + but 没时间 → was going to write。

questions.stem: I ____ halfway, but my friends encouraged me to keep going.
questions.explanation: 过去念头未付诸行动 → was going to give up。

questions.stem: The team ____ from Chengdu, but three friends got injured first.
questions.explanation: 过去计划被打断 → were going to start。

questions.stem: He ____ to the nearest island, but the waves were rising fast.
questions.explanation: 过去打算未实现 → was going to swim。

questions.stem: We ____ on the shore, but the tide came in too quickly.
questions.explanation: 过去打算被潮水打断 → were going to camp。

questions.stem: I ____ the bite with water, but the liquid medicine had run out.
questions.explanation: 过去打算 + but 药用完没做成 → was going to cool。

questions.stem: The guide ____ us up the south ridge, but a landslide blocked the path.
questions.explanation: 过去计划被滑坡打断 → was going to lead。

questions.stem: They ____ the whole journey, but the camera broke on the first day.
questions.explanation: 过去计划未实现 → were going to film。

questions.stem: The biologist promised that he ____ every wonder he saw the next day.
questions.explanation: 转述过去的承诺、事在 the next day → will→would describe。

questions.stem: Verne wrote that one day machines ____ deep beneath the sea.
questions.explanation: 过去主句 + one day 将来,转述将来 → would travel。

questions.stem: Arnette explained that the climb ____ him to look deep inside himself.
questions.explanation: explained 过去、转述当时所说的将来作用 → would force。

questions.stem: Farley said that 'Type T' people ____ taking risks all their lives.
questions.explanation: said 过去 + all their lives(指向将来) → would keep。

questions.stem: Before the trip, we agreed that we ____ every difficulty along the way.
questions.explanation: agreed 过去、所约定之事在旅途将来 → would share。

questions.stem: She said she ____ the next expedition to the South Pole.
questions.explanation: 转述过去的打算:be going to→was going to join。

questions.stem: They told us they ____ the strait before the storm arrived.
questions.explanation: 转述过去的计划 → were going to cross。

questions.stem: He explained that he ____ a book about his undersea adventure.
questions.explanation: explained 过去 + 计划:be going to→was going to write。

questions.stem: The guide reminded us that the thin air ____ us feel weak near the top.
questions.explanation: reminded 过去、所提醒之事指向登顶时 → would make。

questions.stem: Mallory was sure that the mountain ____ him pure joy, not money.
questions.explanation: was sure 过去,转述从过去看的将来 → would give。

questions.stem: The doctor said the bleeding ____ once we pressed the wound firmly.
questions.explanation: said 过去、所说结果尚未发生 → would stop。

questions.stem: I knew that the journey ahead ____ both my body and my mind.
questions.explanation: knew 过去 + ahead(指向将来) → would test。

questions.stem: Tom told me he ____ wreck diving near the Farne Islands.
questions.explanation: 转述过去的打算 → was going to try。

questions.stem: Standing on the deck, none of us guessed those waters ____ our ship apart.
questions.explanation: guessed 过去、当时灾难尚未发生 → would tear。

questions.stem: As a young writer, Verne dreamed that humans ____ the centre of the Earth.
questions.explanation: dreamed 过去,转述对将来的设想 → would reach。

questions.stem: The forecast had warned that the temperature ____ sharply after dark.
questions.explanation: had warned 过去 + after dark(将来) → would fall。

questions.stem: At base camp, we hoped the weather ____ clear until we returned.
questions.explanation: hoped 过去、天气能否维持指向将来 → would stay。

questions.stem: The old sailor often said that he ____ to the sea before he grew too old.
questions.explanation: said 过去 + before he grew too old(将来) → would return。

questions.stem: The captain told the crew that they ____ port the following morning.
questions.explanation: 转述过去的话 + the following morning 将来 → would leave。

questions.stem: We were told that a rescue team ____ for us as soon as the storm passed.
questions.explanation: 转述过去的安排(be going to→was going to);as soon as 引出将来 → was going to search。
